name: TableOfContents
purpose: Finished same-document navigation with current-section feedback and optional logical line indicator.
useWhen: A long document needs a live, explicitly authored section outline.
composition: Compose Root > Nav > Title and List > Item > Link. Indicator is a sibling of List inside Nav. RootProvider shares a useTableOfContents controller without adding a DOM host.

rules.statement: Let Atom's controller own tracking, activation, focus and history; never add consumer scroll listeners to repair current state.
Supply stable unique IDs and heading depths; author localized labels as children. Keep parsing, page layout, sticky offsets and responsive visibility application-owned.
Give Nav a Title or explicit accessible name. Keep nested Lists inside Item and Indicator outside List. Keep native anchors and one aria-current location per Nav.
Use sm/md size, plain/line variant and neutral/accent tone. Load styles.css or core.css plus table-of-contents.css. Do not add focus gutters or override component geometry in playground CSS.

Distinguish the article scroll element from Nav's optional bounded rail viewport. Use managed navigation for scoped scrolling, refresh after external layout changes, and preserve controlled activeId authority.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using Tabs, multiple current links, a second observer or a sticky page-specific component recipe.
commonMistakes.correction: Use TableOfContents behavior and compose page layout outside it.

validation: Check current state after clicks and scrolling, final sections, history, keyboard focus, independent rail scrolling, light/dark, RTL, long labels and reduced motion.
